turns.t: Hi John! Checking in for our upcoming arrival at {L} from {in}. Is there anything we should know before we get there?

Hi {g} — all set for you. Everything you need is below. PARKING: Two cars fit in the driveway. There is also street parking if needed. A level 2 EV charger is available in the carport as needed. ENTRY CODE: - Press the keypad symbol - Enter {code} and press the tick - When you leave, pull the door tight and press the symbol to lock — no code needed - Please adjust the HVAC when leaving to conserve energy BED SETUP: The primary bedroom will be set up as a King unless you prefer 2 Twin XLs. Please let us know. WIFI: Network: {net} Password: {pw} GUIDEBOOK + HOUSE MANUAL: Open the house manual WELCOME: The home has been cleaned and stocked in preparation for your arrival. If you have any issues with the cleanliness, please let us know right away. If you have any questions, issues or concerns during your stay please reach out. If something is off, we want the chance to make it right. Enjoy! If you have any other questions, just let me know. Best, {co} {C} Vacation Rentals
Hi! Our flight lands at 11am on {in}. Any chance we could drop our bags before check-in?
Of course — the cleaners finish around 2pm so the house won’t be ready before then, but you’re welcome to leave bags in the carport closet from 11. The code is {code}.
That’s perfect, thank you! We’ll do that and go find lunch.
One more thing — is there parking for a second car?
Yes, two fit in the driveway and there’s unrestricted street parking on the same side as the house.
Great. One of them is a van with a roof box — will it clear the carport?
It’s 7ft to the beam, so probably not. Put the van on the street and the car in the driveway.
Will do, thanks for checking.
Hi — the wifi dropped out about an hour ago. We’ve tried reconnecting to {net} with no luck.
Sorry about that. There’s a router in the hall cupboard on the top shelf — unplug it for 30 seconds and plug it back in. It takes about two minutes to come back.
Back up, thank you! Working fine now.
We’re having a great time at {L}. Would it be possible to stay two extra nights after {out}?
Those nights are open — I’ll send a change request through so the rate and the total update properly on your side.
Just accepted it. Thanks so much for sorting that out!
Would a 1pm checkout be possible on {out}?
I can do 12 — there’s an arrival the same afternoon and the turnaround is tight. Hope that still helps.
Noon works, no problem at all. Thanks for checking!
Just wanted to say we loved the house. Everything was spotless and the kitchen was a dream.
That’s so good to hear, {g} — you were wonderful guests. You’re welcome back any time.
Of course! We’ll be leaving a very positive review.
We’re outside but the keypad isn’t taking the code. Are we doing something wrong?
Press the symbol at the top FIRST to wake it, then {code} and the tick. It won’t take a code until it lights up.
That was it — we’re in. Thank you!
Any dinner recommendations near {L}? Somewhere we could walk to would be ideal.

Three good ones, all about ten minutes on foot — the little Italian place on the corner, the taqueria two blocks down (cash only), and the wine bar by the park. The guidebook in the kitchen has a longer list.
Perfect, that all makes sense. See you then!
Hi — there’s a stain on one of the bath towels and the upstairs bin hadn’t been emptied.
I’m sorry, that shouldn’t have got past the turnover. Fresh towels are in the hall closet, and housekeeping can come by tomorrow morning — would 9am suit?
9am is fine. Appreciate the quick reply.
She’s been and gone — bins done and a fresh set of towels left in the bathroom. Sorry again for the start of your stay.
All sorted, and no harm done. The house is lovely otherwise.
Would you allow a small dog? She’s house trained and travels with us everywhere.
She’s welcome — there’s a $75 pet fee I’ll add to the reservation, and the yard is fully fenced. Please just keep her off the beds.
Hi John, that’s fantastic. Thank you!!
Hi {g} — looking forward to hosting you on {in}. Roughly what time do you expect to arrive?
We should be there around 5pm, maybe a little later with traffic.
Wonderful — I’ll have everything ready for you.
How does the AC work? It’s reading 78 downstairs and we can’t get it any lower.
The thermostat by the kitchen door runs the whole house — hold the down arrow rather than tapping it, and close the upstairs vents if you want it cooler at night.
Got it down to 72, thank you. Does it run all night or is there a schedule on it?
No schedule, it’ll hold whatever you set. I’d only ask that you turn it up when you’re out for the day.
Of course. Everything else looks great, thanks!
Our flight isn’t until 8pm on {out}. Could we leave bags after we check out?
Yes — leave them in the carport closet and the code stays live until 6pm. If you need anything else just let me know!
Hi John! Booking this one for my mum’s 70th — there’ll be six of us over from Chicago.
What a lovely reason to come. I’ll make sure the house is all set for you.
Thank you! We’d love to do a proper dinner at the house on the Saturday rather than go out.
The table seats eight, and there are two folding chairs in the garage cupboard. The outdoor table is the nicer spot at that time of evening.
That settles it then. Is there any chance of a late checkout on the {out}, so we’re not rushing off after a late one?
It’s our tenth anniversary, which is why we picked somewhere nice. Anywhere you’d send us for dinner one night?
The place on the water two streets over is the one locals book for exactly this — ask for a table on the terrace. Congratulations, by the way. I’ll leave something in the fridge for you.
That’s so kind, thank you! We’ll book it for the Friday.
There’ll be nine of us across two families — my sister’s lot and ours. How do the beds actually work out?
King in the primary, two queens upstairs, and a full-size sofa bed in the den. That’s eight comfortably; the ninth is the airbed in the hall closet, which is a good one.
That works. Are the two queens on the same floor? The cousins will want to be together.
Same landing, sharing the upstairs bathroom. Kids usually end up in there together anyway.
Perfect, that all makes sense. See you then!
We’re in town for a wedding on the {out} — six of us getting ready at the house that morning. Is that alright?
Absolutely, as long as it’s the six on the reservation. The main bathroom has the best light, and there’s a full-length mirror in the primary closet.
Noted, thank you! That’s one less thing to worry about.
I’ll be working two of the days — what’s the wifi actually like, and is there a proper desk?
Fibre, about 400 down, and it holds up on video calls. There’s a desk in the second bedroom with a monitor, a lamp and a decent chair.
That’ll do nicely. Thanks for the detail.
Hi! We’re booked in from {in} — first trip with our 9 month old, so we’re slightly nervous about it.
You’ll be fine, and the house is a good one for it — quiet street, and the pool gate is self-latching.
That’s reassuring. We’re trying very hard not to fly with every single thing she owns.
Very sensible. Tell me what would help most and I’ll see what we already have here.
Do you have baby things like a pack n play? And a high chair, if there’s one going?
Hi John — we arrive on {in} and the kids have talked about nothing but the pool.
Then they’ll be happy. It gets the sun from late morning right through the afternoon.
Good to know. We’re coming from Seattle, so “warm” is relative for us.
Ha — fair enough. It sits around 70°F this time of year without the heater on.
Can we have the pool heated during our stay? And what would that add to the total?
My father uses a walker — how many steps are there to the front door?
Three at the front, but the side gate is step-free straight into the kitchen, and that’s the door I’d use. Both showers have grab rails.
That’s very helpful, thank you. We’ll come in that way.
Could we have a grocery delivery arrive before we check in?
Yes — schedule it after 3pm and the cleaner will put the cold things away if she’s still there. Otherwise the carport closet stays shaded all afternoon.
Booked for 4pm. Thanks so much for sorting that out!
Our flight’s been delayed — we won’t get in until around 1am. Is that going to be a problem?
Not at all, check-in is self-service so any hour works. Code is {code}, and I’ll leave the porch light on for you.
Thank you, that’s one worry gone. Safe to say we’ll sleep in.
The dishwasher is showing an error and won’t drain.
There’s a filter in the bottom that clogs — twist the cap anticlockwise, rinse it and drop it back in. If that doesn’t do it I’ll get someone out tomorrow morning.
Filter was full of rice. Draining fine now, thanks!
Hi {g} — the neighbours mentioned music on the patio quite late last night. No trouble at all, just a heads up that quiet hours here start at 10pm.
So sorry, that was us. We’ll move inside after 10 for the rest of the week.
Appreciated, thank you. Enjoy the rest of your stay.
